UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private user workspace anchor document without PII used as the relational owner root for buh. cloud sync.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user sync workspace was first initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user sync workspace was last updated.

NotePreferences.title: NotePreferences
NotePreferences.description: Per-user ordered note folders and persisted folder expand/collapse state for buh. Cloud Sync.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

folders.description: Ordered list of user note folder names (1 to 50 items, each 1 to 100 chars).

collapsedFolders.description: List of collapsed note folder names (0 to 50 items, each 1 to 100 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated.

WorkspacePreferences.title: WorkspacePreferences
WorkspacePreferences.description: Per-user task lists, app settings, theme/appearance decisions, and recent accent colors for silent buh. Cloud Sync.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

taskLists.description: Ordered list of custom task list names (1 to 50 items, each 1 to 100 chars).

settings.description: User application settings map matching AppSettingsState.

decisions.description: User visual style, navigation mode, quick capture, default home, and hex accent color.

recentColors.description: Recently used accent hex colors (0 to 12 items, each #RRGGBB).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace preferences were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace preferences were last updated.

CloudNote.title: CloudNote
CloudNote.description: A user-owned note document synchronized across devices via buh. Cloud Sync.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

folder.description: Folder name this note belongs to.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to Overview.

markdownEnabled.description: Whether live markdown formatting is enabled for this note.

blocks.description: Ordered list of structured note blocks (up to 250 maps with id, type, text, optional checked).

sortOrder.description: Optional numeric sort key used to persist custom shifted note ordering across devices.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created in cloud sync.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

CloudTask.title: CloudTask
CloudTask.description: A user-owned local task synchronized silently across devices via buh. Cloud Sync.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the task owner.

timeLabel.description: Task due time label (e.g., '09:00 AM' or 'No time set').

dateKey.description: Local due date key in YYYY-MM-DD format (or empty string).

completedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when task was completed.

isInbox.description: Whether the task belongs to Inbox.

subtasks.description: Ordered list of subtasks (up to 100 maps with id, title, done).

recurrence.description: Optional recurrence rule map (frequency, interval, optional daysOfWeek, optional endDateKey).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created in cloud sync.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated.

CloudEvent.title: CloudEvent
CloudEvent.description: A user-owned local schedule block synchronized silently across devices via buh. Cloud Sync.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the schedule block owner.

dateKey.description: Start date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDateKey.description: Optional multi-day end date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule block was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule block was last updated.

CloudLookupEntry.title: CloudLookupEntry
CloudLookupEntry.description: A user-owned Lookup Q&A history entry synchronized across devices via buh. Cloud Sync.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Lookup entry owner.

sources.description: Grounded citation sources (up to 30 maps with title and uri).

media.description: Grounded image and video preview items (up to 20 maps).

webSearchQueries.description: Search queries executed for grounding (up to 20 strings, each <= 300 chars).

usedAgenda.description: Whether personal agenda context was included in this Lookup query.

savedTask.description: Whether this Lookup entry has been saved as a task.

savedTaskId.description: Optional ID of the task created from this Lookup entry.

savedNote.description: Whether this Lookup entry has been saved as a note.

savedNoteId.description: Optional ID of the note created from this Lookup entry.

orderMs.description: Epoch milliseconds for stable chronological ordering across devices.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Lookup entry was created in cloud sync.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Lookup entry was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User workspace root document (PII-free) verifying account ownership for subcollections.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-owned notes synced in real time across devices.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-owned local tasks synced silently in real time across devices.

/users/{userId}/events/{eventId}.description: User-owned local schedule time blocks synced silently in real time across devices.

/users/{userId}/lookupEntries/{entryId}.description: User-owned Lookup Q&A history entries synced silently in real time across devices.
